editorial:
Picture this: a group of friends head to a remote cabin in the woods to help one of them kick a drug habit. Mia is the one trying to get clean, and her brother David, his girlfriend Natalie, and their friends Olivia and Eric are there to support her. It sounds like a serious drama at first, but things take a dark turn fast. Eric finds a creepy old book and reads from it, waking up something evil. Before you know it, Mia gets possessed, and the cabin becomes a nightmare. The vibe is intense, bloody, and relentless from start to finish.

The acting is solid, especially Jane Levy as Mia, who goes through a wild transformation. The practical effects are impressive and gross in the best way. The pacing never slows down, which keeps you on edge. On the downside, it is extremely gory, so if you have a weak stomach, this is not for you. There is also not much humor to break the tension. If you love hardcore horror and do not mind blood, you will have a blast. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Mia fights back against the demon after being buried alive and coming back. She uses a chainsaw to cut off her own possessed hand and then battles the Abomination, a twisted version of herself, in the pouring rain. She manages to destroy it by feeding it into a wood chipper. David dies earlier trying to save her, and Mia walks away alone, bloodied but alive, as the rain stops. It is a brutal but satisfying ending where the hero survives by becoming tougher than the evil.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves hardcore horror and practical gore effects.
